name: Sample Person A
headline: Senior Backend Engineer
summary: Backend engineer with 7 years of experience building Python APIs and data services on AWS. Focused on reliable, well-tested systems, PostgreSQL performance, and container-based deployments.

bullets: Designed and built FastAPI microservices handling 2M requests per day on AWS ECS.
Reduced PostgreSQL query latency by 60% through indexing and query rewrites.
Migrated services from EC2 to Kubernetes (EKS) using Terraform, cutting deploy time from 40 to 8 minutes.
Mentored three junior engineers and introduced code review guidelines.
Built Django REST APIs for a payments dashboard used by 300 merchant accounts.
Implemented background jobs with Celery and Redis for nightly settlement reports.
Set up GitLab CI pipelines with automated tests and Docker image builds.
Wrote Python scripts to automate data imports from CSV into PostgreSQL.
Fixed bugs and added unit tests to an internal Django application.
